title: Hyperthyroidism as a Potential Predictive of Worse Outcome of Renal Graft
official: Hyperthyroidism in the Immediate Post-kidney Transplantation Period: a Potential Predictive of Worse Outcome of Renal Graft
summary: The objectives of the study are: to research the association, if any, between the occurrence of thyroid function changes in the immediate post-transplant period and the prognosis of the transplant itself; identify any risk factors for the occurrence of thyroid disorders In the immediate post-transplant period.
